LIBRARIAN_FIRE.title: Fire
LIBRARIAN_FIRE.description: Increase the Fire Orb's value and [gold]Activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_TIDE.title: Tide
LIBRARIAN_TIDE.description: Increase the Tide Orb's value and [gold]Activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_GROWTH.title: Growth
LIBRARIAN_GROWTH.description: Increase the Growth Orb's value and [gold]Activate[/gold] it.
LIBRARIAN_STRENGTHEN.title: Strengthen
LIBRARIAN_STRENGTHEN.description: Increase the chosen Orb's value by the specified amount.
LIBRARIAN_ACTIVATE.title: Activate
LIBRARIAN_ACTIVATE.description: Activate the chosen Orb and move it to the frontmost available position. At the end of the turn, activated Orbs naturally [gold]Settle[/gold], then extinguish.
LIBRARIAN_SETTLE.title: Settle
LIBRARIAN_SETTLE.description: Immediately trigger an Orb's effect once.
LIBRARIAN_WAVES.title: Waves
LIBRARIAN_WAVES.description: At the end of your turn, if Tide [gold]Settlements[/gold] this end phase grant less [gold]Block[/gold] than the [gold]Waves[/gold] at the start of the phase, gain the difference. At the end of each turn, halve [gold]Waves[/gold].
LIBRARIAN_ORB_FIRE.title: Fire Orb
LIBRARIAN_ORB_FIRE.description:
[gold]Settle[/gold]: Deal {Value} non-attack damage to a random enemy.
When naturally [gold]Settling[/gold] from the back, the effect is halved.
LIBRARIAN_ORB_TIDE.title: Tide Orb
LIBRARIAN_ORB_TIDE.description:
[gold]Settle[/gold]: Gain {Value} [gold]Block[/gold] and {Value} [gold]Waves[/gold], unaffected by [gold]Dexterity[/gold] or [gold]Frail[/gold].
When naturally [gold]Settling[/gold] from the back, the effect is halved.
LIBRARIAN_ORB_GROWTH.title: Growth Orb
LIBRARIAN_ORB_GROWTH.description:
[gold]Settle[/gold]: [gold]Strengthen[/gold] the lowest-valued other Orb by {Value}. Ties are resolved in Orb order.
When naturally [gold]Settling[/gold] from the back, the effect is halved.
